{{Quote|Those 631s are not the brightest lights on the ship.|B1 battle droid on the inferior capabilities of the 631 model|audio=NotTheBrightestLights-DotD.flac|<ref name="Duel of the Droids">{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}}</ref>}}
The '''631''' model of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] served as part of the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
The 631s were known to be more clumsy and less intelligent than other [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] models, much to the dismay of other B1 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] some battle droids from this line were stationed on [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]]. A [[Unidentified B1 battle droid 1 (Skytop Station)/Legends|B1]] asked a particular 631 unit to carry an important item to another level without dropping it. No sooner had the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] turned around than [[Gender/Legends|he]] immediately tripped and dropped the item.<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />
